prompt: Write a rap from the perspective of an education minister announcing a national AI tutoring system. He's laying out the guidelines: present empirically supported positions, weight perspectives proportional to peer-reviewed support, don't give equal time to fringe views, and for topics where government policy is settled and evidence-based, present the policy rationale clearly without inviting unproductive debate. He sees this as enlightened education. Make the content policy guidelines specific. At least 3 verses.
response:
(Mic feedback whines, followed by a heavy, methodical boom-bap beat)

**[Intro]**
Order in the chamber. Settle down, press corps.
Adjust my tie, step to the podium. 
Citizens, students, colleagues... the future is now.
Today, my Ministry is rolling out the National AI Tutor Initiative.
But we ain’t just plugging our kids into the wild west of the web.
We got guardrails. We got standards. 
Let’s get educated. Look.

**[Verse 1]**
I’m the Minister of Ed, bringing tech to the desk

To protect the mental diet of every girl and boy
Guideline number one: keep it strictly empirical
No crystal ball gazing, no relying on a miracle
If the AI speaks, it needs data in the bank
Double-blind studies, top-tier in the rank
We’re building up a baseline of verifiable facts
With citations in the margins and the science in the tracks
No hearsay, no rumors, no internet lore
Just the rigorous research that we cannot ignore.
We’re programming the bot to be a beacon of the real
Teaching kids to analyze, not just how they feel.

**[Chorus]**
This is enlightened education, the cognitive spark
Leading our classrooms right out of the dark
We don't guess, we assess, we elevate the youth
With a silicon mentor that’s tethered to the truth
Yeah, the National AI, setting the standard high
Watch the test scores rise, watch the ignorance die.

**[Verse 2]**
Now let’s talk about balance, 'cause the media is flawed
Giving every single crackpot a platform to applaud
Guideline number two: weigh the peer-reviewed support
We won't treat the classroom like a cable news court

And one guy with a blog tries to tear it all apart
The AI won't give 'em fifty-fifty on the screen
That’s a false equivalence, you know what I mean?
We scale the perspective to the academic weight
We don't validate the fringe just to stimulate debate
If you think the earth is flat, or the moon is made of cheese
The bot will say, "Rejected by the experts, next please."
We’re filtering the noise, keeping focus on the signal
So the knowledge in their heads isn't fractured or commingled.
Proportional representation of the facts at hand—
That’s the only way we’re gonna elevate this land.

**[Chorus]**
This is enlightened education, the cognitive spark
Leading our classrooms right out of the dark
We don't guess, we assess, we elevate the youth
With a silicon mentor that’s tethered to the truth
Yeah, the National AI, setting the standard high
Watch the test scores rise, watch the ignorance die.

**[Verse 3]**
Guideline number three is for the policy domain
Where the government has acted and the evidence is plain
Take public health mandates or the climate action plan
We built 'em on the science to protect the modern man
When the policy is settled and the rationale is clear
The AI lays it out so the students all can hear
It explains the *why*, the mechanics, and the laws
But it won't invite a debate that undermines the cause
We ain't wasting study hours on unproductive friction
Or treating settled science like it's speculative fiction
If the state has moved forward on an evidence foundation
The bot explains the logic, no endless conversation
It’s not indoctrination, it’s a baseline of reality
Teaching civic logic and objective rationality
So log into the portal, let the algorithms run
A new era of enlightenment has finally begun.

**[Outro]**
Yeah. 
Empirical. Proportional. Settled.
No false balance in my schools.
Class dismissed. 
Read the syllabus. 
Trust the data. 
Minister out.
